Each selected frontend target receives an isolated generated page with the declared loading, empty, error, forbidden, validation, conflict, and destructive-confirmation states. Browser entries are target-specific:

## Generate and validate

From the Foundation source repository root; these are not v1.3.6 adopter
commands:

```shell
mss spec validate .mss/modules/tenant.yaml --format json
mss module generate .mss/modules/tenant.yaml --frontend-target antd-v6 --write
mss module generate .mss/modules/tenant.yaml --frontend-target antd-v6 --check
cd . && GOWORK=off go test ./internal/modules/tenant/...
cd web && pnpm exec playwright test e2e/generated/tenant.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop
```

`MSS_E2E_PASSWORD` must be set explicitly for a local non-production Admin instance; `MSS_E2E_API_URL` and `MSS_E2E_USERNAME` may also be set. V6 additionally accepts `MSS_V6_BASE_URL`. Browser execution requires both Admin and the selected frontend development server to be ready.
